name: stream-submission
trigger: SubmitRequested on a fixed partition list
preconditions: Open edition; valid authorized stream; required details; source version pinned
rejection_action: Retain draft and return redacted validation errors
notification: Protected outbox; safe record reference only; delivery may be duplicated after uncertain send
escalation: Configurable event-hours SLA to authorized supervisor; no sensitive payload
failure: Try/Catch; bounded 429/503 retry; honor Retry-After; dead-letter permission/validation errors; resume staged receipt
audit: Trusted actor object ID, UTC time, source version, action, correlation ID, outcome; no banking/identity/contact payload
idempotency: Unique server-derived request+stage keys; reject changed payload; ETag conditional writes
recovery: Prepared/Reserved/Committed receipt stages and scheduled reconciliation; SharePoint has no multi-list transaction
